input.summary:
Committee room east furnished in parts/room-9.mjs: a dark oak committee table (fence legs, slab top) at x29..31 z12 with three chairs on its north side and end chairs at x28 and x32, bookshelves at both ends, a barrel and a flower pot, and hanging lanterns at x26, x30, x34 y15.
make.sh saved a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines for this part; `$MCD room` reports OK (39 of 39 floor cells reachable, min light 8, 0 dark cells).
The interior eye view reads as a table with chairs, and the lane from the door at x25 z13 stays clear.
left: plan.md's checklist has no line for the room parts, and elements.md item 23 (interior, shared by all rooms) is not ticked; this part covers only the Committee room east share of it.
The room is three cells deep, so the committee table reads as a bench from above; `rooms --out room.png` at this scale was too small to judge the furniture, and the eye view was the useful check.
Lighting is hanging lanterns only; no candles or lectern on the table. Light is at least 8 everywhere, so nothing is needed there.

waste.what: Worked out the layout column by column by hand: each row string had to be counted against x23..x35 (13 cells) and each layer checked for length and alignment.
waste.cost: about 6 row strings, 2 layers and 3 counting retries
waste.tool: A `layers` dry-run or length check that reports the x range of each row against the room box, or a `$MCD plan` option that prints the rows with x labels for copying.

waste.what: Chair facings (stairs back toward the wall, seats facing the table) and the table's fence-plus-slab construction were decided by hand from the doc comments.
waste.cost: a few minutes of reasoning, no retries
waste.tool: A furniture helper such as deskSet or councilTable from vocab (named in plan.md but not in the vocab files shipped here), which would emit facing-correct chairs and tables.

waste.what: The rooms --out render from above was too small and occluded to read furniture, so I rendered an interior eye view with render --eye to check it.
waste.tool: `$MCD rooms` should default to a readable size or add an interior eye view for small rooms, so one command gives the look.

companions.task: Build the bookshelf ends and the committee table so their joints and fence legs read as real furniture, rather than a placed set of blocks.
Review the three hanging lanterns and their spacing against the room's light map so the table gets the brightest light and no cell falls under 8.
